notes.title: Goop Patch
notes.notes:
I have added new tutorial markers in the intro section.

I have changed ziplines and mirrors to use a keypress to activate instead of auto-activating.

After receiving feedback, I've modified the goop so that it all destroys from a single shot. This should also lead to a slight boost in loading times.

notes.title: Dialogue Volume Patch
notes.notes:
I have patched the game so all dialogue volume is at a similar volume. If anyone runs into any other issues please do not hesitate to let me know in the Steam Community page. 

Thank you,
Jackson Clayton
